literature.headline_zh: 尼帕病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期尼帕病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 严重性推动显着增加了感知的严重性和行动线索,而好处推动增加了行动线索。这两种推动都不影响及时寻求医疗护理。中介分析表明,严重性推动通过感知严重性对 治疗 意图产生显着间接影响,而利益推动则对 疫苗接种 和 治疗 意图产生显着间接影响。 [10.7189/jogh.16.04362]
自 1994 年以来,澳大利亚东部各州几乎每年都会报告亨德拉病毒 (HeV),而人类中的 尼帕病毒 (NiV) 暴发 于 1998-99 年首次在马来西亚和新加坡报告,印度和孟加拉国几乎每年都会报告。 [Ontwikkeling van strategieën ter behandeling en preventie van henipavirusinfecties]
使用杆状病毒表达的截短 NiV G 胞外域(残基 170-575)对两只羊驼进行免疫;来自高反应动物的外周血单核细胞被用来构建 3.2 × 108 转化体的免疫噬菌体展示库。 [10.3390/vetsci13111209]
VC033_V6_BD_L03 构建体被优先考虑为主要候选者,并显示全球和南亚的综合预测人口覆盖率为 99.78% 和 99.96%。 [10.64898/2026.11.05.764467]
咨询确定了 疫苗、单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和小分子治疗 (SMT) 在 NiV 预防、暴露后保护和 治疗 方面的独特作用。 [10.1038/s41541-026-01608-4]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The severity nudge significantly increased perceived severity and cues to action, while the benefits nudge increased cues to action. Neither nudge influenced promptly seeking medical care. [10.7189/jogh.16.04362]

Hendra virus (HeV) has been reported nearly annually since 1994 in the eastern states of Australia, while Nipah virus (NiV) outbreaks in humans were first reported in 1998-99 in Malaysia and Singapore and are reported almost annually in India and Bangladesh. [Ontwikkeling van strategieën ter behandeling en preventie van henipavirusinfecties]

Two alpacas were immunized with a baculovirus-expressed, truncated NiV G ectodomain (residues 170–575); peripheral blood mononuclear cells from the higher-responding animal were used to build an immune phage display library of 3.2 × 108 transformants. [10.3390/vetsci13111209]
VC033_V6_BD_L03 construct was prioritized as the lead candidate and showed combined predicted population coverage of 99.78% worldwide and 99.96% in South Asia. [10.64898/2026.11.05.764467]

The consultation identified distinct roles for vaccines, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), and small-molecule therapeutics (SMTs) in the context of NiV prevention, post-exposure protection, and treatment. [10.1038/s41541-026-01608-4]

papers.title: Information nudging, attitude, and protective behaviours against Nipah virus in India, 2026: a national experimental survey
papers.abstract: Background: Nipah virus (NiV) poses a significant public health threat due to its high fatality, yet public readiness for medical countermeasures remains understudied. We aimed to evaluate the associations of perceived severity and benefits information nudges with the dimensions of the Health Belief Model (HBM), identify highly responsive populations, and assess whether changes in HBM dimensions mediate the associations between information nudges and protective behavioural intentions in India. Methods: We conducted a nationwide experimental web survey among Indian adults between 6 and 18 February 2026. The survey contained an embedded information nudge module in which participants were randomly assigned to one of three groups: a perceived severity nudge, a perceived benefits nudge, or no nudge. We assessed changes in HBM dimensions using analysis of covariance. Six predictive models were evaluated to identify subpopulations highly susceptible to cognitive shifts. Mediation analyses were performed to estimate the indirect effects of nudges on intentions to promptly seek medical care, receive vaccination, and accept treatment. Results: Our sample comprised 1,124 participants randomly assigned to receive a perceived severity nudge (n = 373), a perceived benefits nudge (n = 376), or no nudge (n = 375). Compared with no nudge, the severity nudge significantly increased perceived severity (adjusted mean difference (AMD) = 0.17; 95% confidence interval (CI) = 0.05, 0.30; P = 0.005) and cues to action (AMD = 0.20; 95% CI = 0.09, 0.32; P < 0.001), while the benefits nudge significantly increased cues to action (0.30; 95% CI = 0.19, 0.41; P < 0.001). Predictive modelling (extreme gradient boosting: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) = 0.717; logistic regression: AUROC = 0.789) identified baseline health beliefs and residence outside prior outbreak regions as dominant contributors to nudge responsiveness. Mediation analyses indicated significant indirect effects of the severity nudge on treatment intention via perceived severity (effect estimate (β) = 0.016; 95% CI = 0.002, 0.032), as well as the perceived benefits nudge via cues to action on both vaccination intention (β = 0.024; 95% CI = 0.001, 0.054) and treatment intention (β = 0.028; 95% CI = 0.002, 0.055). Neither information nudge significantly influenced promptly seeking medical care. Conclusions: Targeted information nudges could alter health beliefs and influence vaccination and treatment readiness through distinct psychological pathways.

papers.source_body_en: Background: Nipah virus (NiV) poses a significant public health threat due to its high fatality, yet public readiness for medical countermeasures remains understudied. We aimed to evaluate the associations of perceived severity and benefits information nudges with the dimensions of the Health Belief Model (HBM), identify highly responsive populations, and assess whether changes in HBM dimensions mediate the associations between information nudges and protective behavioural intentions in India. Methods: We conducted a nationwide experimental web survey among Indian adults between 6 and 18 February 2026. The survey contained an embedded information nudge module in which participants were randomly assigned to one of three groups: a perceived severity nudge, a perceived benefits nudge, or no nudge. We assessed changes in HBM dimensions using analysis of covariance. Six predictive models were evaluated to identify subpopulations highly susceptible to cognitive shifts. Mediation analyses were performed to estimate the indirect effects of nudges on intentions to promptly seek medical care, receive vaccination, and accept treatment. Results: Our sample comprised 1,124 participants randomly assigned to receive a perceived severity nudge (n = 373), a perceived benefits nudge (n = 376), or no nudge (n = 375). Compared with no nudge, the severity nudge significantly increased perceived severity (adjusted mean difference (AMD) = 0.17; 95% confidence interval (CI) = 0.05, 0.30; P = 0.005) and cues to action (AMD = 0.20; 95% CI = 0.09, 0.32; P < 0.001), while the benefits nudge significantly increased cues to action (0.30; 95% CI = 0.19, 0.41; P < 0.001). Predictive modelling (extreme gradient boosting: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) = 0.717; logistic regression: AUROC = 0.789) identified baseline health beliefs and residence outside prior outbreak regions as dominant contributors to nudge responsiveness. Mediation analyses indicated significant indirect effects of the severity nudge on treatment intention via perceived severity (effect estimate (β) = 0.016; 95% CI = 0.002, 0.032), as well as the perceived benefits nudge via cues to action on both vaccination intention (β = 0.024; 95% CI = 0.001, 0.054) and treatment intention (β = 0.028; 95% CI = 0.002, 0.055). Neither information nudge significantly influenced promptly seeking medical care. Conclusions: Targeted information nudges could alter health beliefs and influence vaccination and treatment readiness through distinct psychological pathways.

papers.title: Deterministic–stochastic fractional-order modeling and optimal control of Nipah virus in hypertensive nephrosclerosis
papers.abstract: Nipah virus is a zoonotic virus that causes severe respiratory and neurological disease and is spread through pigs, bats or contaminated food. This research develops a fractional-order mathematical model to investigate the co-infection dynamics of hypertensive nephrosclerosis and Nipah virus infection. The model is kept positive and bounded to guarantee biological reality, and the disease-free equilibrium E p l is studied. The basic reproduction number R 0 l p < 1 implies extinction of the infection while R 0 l p > 1 implies small outbreaks developing into epidemics. These results are backed up by bifurcation analysis, global stability analysis and existence and uniqueness proofs for the solution. Real Malaysian co-infection data was used to parameterise the model, and simulations were carried out for both deterministic and stochastic fractional systems. The fractional-order parameter has significant impact on the infection rates and convergence behaviour. The memory effects and nonlocal dynamics are described by using piecewise Caputo–Fabrizio derivatives. Stochastic perturbations are considered to model random environmental effects. The parameters were changed to highlight the role of vaccination and stochasticity in disease extinction. The amalgamation of Caputo–Fabrizio fractional calculus and stochastic modelling, supported by a novel numerical scheme, offers a robust and flexible approach to simulate co-infection dynamics under uncertainty. The framework is further validated by PRCC sensitivity analysis and MCMC parameter estimation. Optimal control strategies provide to control the co-infection spread with economic feasibility. To summarize, the model provides useful insights into the interaction between hypertensive nephrosclerosis and Nipah virus transmission, supporting the design of effective and economically feasible control strategies.

papers.title: Development of a Pan-Proteome Multi-Epitope Vaccine Candidate Against Nipah Virus Using Reverse Vaccinology and Immunoinformatics Approaches
papers.abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is a high-consequence zoonotic pathogen for which no licensed human vaccine is currently available. This study applied a consensus-guided pan-proteome immunoinformatics framework to design and prioritize a multi-epitope vaccine candidate using sequence information from all nine NiV proteins. A total of 901 NiV protein sequences were retrieved, of which 842 passed quality filtering and were processed through clustering, multiple-sequence alignment, and protein-specific consensus generation. Consensus-derived fragments were screened for cytotoxic T-lymphocyte, helper T-lymphocyte, and B-cell epitopes, followed by multi-criterion filtering based on antigenicity, allergenicity, toxicity, conservancy, class-specific immune-response properties, and human-proteome similarity. Ten epitope-selection strategies were combined with two adjuvant candidates and three construct architectures to generate 60 vaccine constructs. Shortlisted candidates were subsequently evaluated for physicochemical properties, HLA population coverage, structural characteristics, conformational B-cell epitopes, TLR3 docking, molecular dynamics, immune-response simulation, and expression-oriented optimization. VC033_V6_BD_L03 construct was prioritized as the lead candidate and showed combined predicted population coverage of 99.78% worldwide and 99.96% in South Asia. Docking against human TLR3 structure 1ZIW yielded a ClusPro score of -1624.8. During a 100-ns molecular-dynamics simulation, the complex underwent early conformational reorganization followed by lower late-phase structural variation and persistent interchain hydrogen bonding. MM/GBSA analysis yielded a mean interaction-energy estimate of -20.52, 15.42 kcal/mol. C-ImmSim predicted coordinated humoral and cellular responses, while codon optimization generated a 1,539-bp expression sequence compatible with virtual cloning into pET-28a(+). These analyses prioritize VC033_V6_BD_L03 as a consensus-derived, pan-proteome NiV multi-epitope vaccine candidate for experimental evaluation of expression, immunogenicity, safety, and protective efficacy.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究应用共识引导的泛蛋白质组免疫信息学框架,使用所有九种 NiV 蛋白的序列信息来设计和优先考虑多表位 疫苗 候选者。总共检索到 901 个 NiV 蛋白序列,其中 842 个通过质量过滤,并通过聚类、多序列比对和蛋白质特异性共识生成进行处理。
elements_zh.methods: 对共识衍生片段进行细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞、辅助 T 淋巴细胞和 B 细胞表位筛选,然后根据抗原性、过敏原性、毒性、保守性、类特异性免疫反应特性和人类蛋白质组相似性进行多标准过滤。将十种表位选择策略与两种候选佐剂和三种构建体架构相结合,生成 60 个 疫苗 构建体。
elements_zh.main_results: VC033_V6_BD_L03 构建体被优先考虑为主要候选者,并显示全球和南亚的综合预测人口覆盖率为 99.78% 和 99.96%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为优先考虑将 VC033_V6_BD_L03 作为共识衍生的泛蛋白质组 NiV 多表位 疫苗 候选药物,用于表达、免疫原性、安全性和保护功效的实验评估。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对 尼帕病毒 的 疫苗 候选药物的开发提供信息,以进行进一步的实验评估和预防 NiV 感染和疾病的潜在用途。

papers.title_zh: 使用反向疫苗学和免疫信息学方法开发针对 尼帕病毒 的泛蛋白质组多表位 疫苗 候选药物
papers.source_body_en: Nipah virus (NiV) is a high-consequence zoonotic pathogen for which no licensed human vaccine is currently available. This study applied a consensus-guided pan-proteome immunoinformatics framework to design and prioritize a multi-epitope vaccine candidate using sequence information from all nine NiV proteins. A total of 901 NiV protein sequences were retrieved, of which 842 passed quality filtering and were processed through clustering, multiple-sequence alignment, and protein-specific consensus generation. Consensus-derived fragments were screened for cytotoxic T-lymphocyte, helper T-lymphocyte, and B-cell epitopes, followed by multi-criterion filtering based on antigenicity, allergenicity, toxicity, conservancy, class-specific immune-response properties, and human-proteome similarity. Ten epitope-selection strategies were combined with two adjuvant candidates and three construct architectures to generate 60 vaccine constructs. Shortlisted candidates were subsequently evaluated for physicochemical properties, HLA population coverage, structural characteristics, conformational B-cell epitopes, TLR3 docking, molecular dynamics, immune-response simulation, and expression-oriented optimization. VC033_V6_BD_L03 construct was prioritized as the lead candidate and showed combined predicted population coverage of 99.78% worldwide and 99.96% in South Asia. Docking against human TLR3 structure 1ZIW yielded a ClusPro score of -1624.8. During a 100-ns molecular-dynamics simulation, the complex underwent early conformational reorganization followed by lower late-phase structural variation and persistent interchain hydrogen bonding. MM/GBSA analysis yielded a mean interaction-energy estimate of -20.52, 15.42 kcal/mol. C-ImmSim predicted coordinated humoral and cellular responses, while codon optimization generated a 1,539-bp expression sequence compatible with virtual cloning into pET-28a(+). These analyses prioritize VC033_V6_BD_L03 as a consensus-derived, pan-proteome NiV multi-epitope vaccine candidate for experimental evaluation of expression, immunogenicity, safety, and protective efficacy.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尼帕病毒 (NiV) 是一种后果严重的人畜共患病原体,目前尚无获得许可的人类 疫苗。本研究旨在利用免疫信息学方法开发针对 NiV 的 疫苗 候选药物。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究应用共识引导的泛蛋白质组免疫信息学框架,使用所有九种 NiV 蛋白的序列信息来设计和优先考虑多表位 疫苗 候选者。总共检索到 901 个 NiV 蛋白序列,其中 842 个通过质量过滤,并通过聚类、多序列比对和蛋白质特异性共识生成进行处理。
analysis_zh.methods: 对共识衍生片段进行细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞、辅助 T 淋巴细胞和 B 细胞表位筛选,然后根据抗原性、过敏原性、毒性、保守性、类特异性免疫反应特性和人类蛋白质组相似性进行多标准过滤。将十种表位选择策略与两种候选佐剂和三种构建体架构相结合,生成 60 个 疫苗 构建体。
analysis_zh.main_results: VC033_V6_BD_L03 构建体被优先考虑为主要候选者,并显示全球和南亚的综合预测人口覆盖率为 99.78% 和 99.96%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为优先考虑将 VC033_V6_BD_L03 作为共识衍生的泛蛋白质组 NiV 多表位 疫苗 候选药物,用于表达、免疫原性、安全性和保护功效的实验评估。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对 尼帕病毒 的 疫苗 候选药物的开发提供信息,以进行进一步的实验评估和预防 NiV 感染和疾病的潜在用途。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于计算和计算机分析,并且证据强度中等,因为结果基于预测的特性而不是实验验证。

papers.title: Stakeholder-informed use cases and target product characteristics for vaccines and therapeutics for Nipah virus disease
papers.abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is a deadly zoonotic pathogen with potential for severe outbreaks. We convened a multi-stakeholder expert consultation to define potential implementation strategies and use cases for NiV countermeasures across hypothetical outbreak scenarios and conditions. Participants identified distinct roles for vaccines, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), and small-molecule therapeutics (SMTs) for prevention, post-exposure protection, and treatment. These stakeholder-informed outputs are intended to inform product development, target product profiles, and equitable access during future outbreaks.
authors: On behalf of the Nipah Countermeasure Use Case Working Group

papers.title: Observation of Nipah Virus Evolution Using the ATG Genomic Walks
papers.abstract: In this paper, 32 complete genomic sequences of human-origin Nipah viruses registered in GenBank® from 1999 to 2025 are analyzed by tracking distributions of ATG triplets. The trajectories of these triplets are constructed, and their divergence parameter is calculated, revealing an increased value typical of highly mutated viruses that can form separate families with distinct properties. This conclusion aligns with the large deviation observed in the fractal dimension parameters of the distribution of inter-ATG-triplet distances in genomic sequences. The simulation results are compared with earlier data for SARS-CoV-2, MERS-CoV, dengue, and Ebola viruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the evolution of Nipah virus by analyzing the distribution of ATG triplets in its genomic sequences, addressing the need to understand how such viruses mutate and develop distinct properties over time.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 32 complete genomic sequences of human-origin Nipah viruses registered in GenBank® from 1999 to 2025, focusing on the trajectories of ATG triplets and their divergence parameters.
analysis.methods: The researchers constructed trajectories of ATG triplets and calculated divergence parameters to assess mutations, comparing these results with earlier data for other viruses such as SARS-CoV-2, MERS-CoV, dengue, and Ebola.
analysis.main_results: The divergence parameter of ATG triplets showed an increased value, indicating a high mutation rate typical of viruses that can form separate families with distinct properties.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that Nipah virus exhibits significant mutational divergence, which may contribute to its ability to form distinct families with unique characteristics, offering novel insights into its evolutionary dynamics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform future surveillance and diagnostic strategies for Nipah virus, as well as contribute to understanding its potential for genetic adaptation and emergence of new variants.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on genomic sequences from a specific time period and does not account for environmental or host factors influencing mutation rates, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

The divergence parameter of these triplets was found to increase, suggesting a high mutation rate and the potential for forming distinct viral families. The results align with observations of large deviations in fractal dimension parameters of inter-ATG-triplet distances, indicating significant genetic variation. These findings provide insights into the mutational dynamics of Nipah virus, which could inform future surveillance and diagnostic efforts. However, the study's reliance on genomic data without considering environmental or host factors limits its generalizability, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.title: Immunogenicity of an Fc-Fused Nipah Virus Attachment Glycoprotein Vaccine Candidate
papers.abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) comprises two major genotypes, the Malaysia (NiV-M) and Bangladesh (NiV-B) strains. It is a zoonotic pathogen with high virulence in humans and pigs. The attachment glycoprotein (G) is considered a target for NiV vaccine development. Here, we report an Fc-G fusion protein, generated by fusing the ectodomain of NiV-B G to an immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) fragment crystallizable (Fc), and evaluated its immunogenicity in three animal species. In mice, Fc-G was evaluated together with an unfused G comparator and induced potent G-specific antibody levels and strong neutralizing activity against NiV pseudovirus. Robust antibody responses were elicited in Fc-G-immunized Syrian hamsters and pigs; high-level neutralizing antibodies against both NiV-M and NiV-B were also detected. Neutralizing antibody titers remained high at 91 days post-immunization in hamsters. These findings demonstrate that Fc-G elicits robust, durable binding and cross-reactive neutralizing antibody responses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估 Fc 融合 尼帕病毒 附着糖蛋白 疫苗 候选物的免疫原性。尼帕病毒 (NiV) 包括两种主要基因型,即马来西亚株 (NiV-M) 和孟加拉国株 (NiV-B),它们是人畜共患病原体,对人和猪具有高毒力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在小鼠、叙利亚仓鼠和猪等三种动物中进行,以评估 Fc-G 融合蛋白的免疫原性。在小鼠中将 疫苗 候选物与未融合的 G 比较物进行比较。
elements_zh.methods: Fc-G 融合蛋白是通过将 NiV-BG 的胞外域与可结晶的免疫球蛋白 G1 (IgG1) 片段 (Fc) 融合而产生的。通过测量小鼠、叙利亚仓鼠和猪体内的 G 特异性抗体水平和针对 NiV 假病毒的中和活性来评估免疫原性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在小鼠中,Fc-G 诱导有效的 G 特异性抗体水平和针对 NiV 假病毒的强中和活性。在 Fc-G 免疫的叙利亚仓鼠和猪中引发了强烈的抗体反应,检测到针对 NiV-M 和 NiV-B 毒株的高水平中和抗体。仓鼠免疫后 91 天,中和抗体滴度仍然很高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,Fc-G 能引发强大、持久的结合和交叉反应中和抗体反应,这对于 疫苗 针对 疫苗 的开发至关重要。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为了解 Fc-G 作为 尼帕病毒 的 疫苗 候选者的潜力提供了重要见解,支持其在 监测、诊断 中的使用以及动物和人类群体中 NiV 感染的预防策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于动物模型,证据基于小鼠、仓鼠和猪的免疫原性评估,这可能无法完全转化为人类结果。由于依赖动物数据且缺乏临床试验结果,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Identification and Fc-Formatting of Alpaca Single-Domain Antibodies Targeting the Nipah Virus Attachment Glycoprotein
papers.abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is a WHO priority pathogen with case-fatality rates of 40–75%, and no antiviral therapeutic is licensed for human use. The attachment glycoprotein (G) mediates receptor engagement and is a validated target for neutralizing antibodies. Here, we aimed to isolate alpaca-derived single-domain antibodies (VHHs) against the NiV G head domain. Two alpacas were immunized with a baculovirus-expressed, truncated NiV G ectodomain (residues 170–575); peripheral blood mononuclear cells from the higher-responding animal were used to build an immune phage display library of 3.2 × 108 transformants. Four rounds of biopanning enriched antigen-specific phages approximately 120-fold, and sequencing of 183 reactive clones yielded seven unique VHHs. All seven bound to recombinant NiV G, observed by ELISA, and inhibited entry of a VSV-based NiV pseudovirus. VHH-0G8 and VHH-1B6 were most active, with fitted IC50 values of 1.34 and 1.76 μg/mL (≈89 and 118 nM). Reformatting the two leads as human IgG1 Fc-YTE fusions lowered the fitted IC50 to 0.97 and 1.09 μg/mL (≈12 and 13 nM); because a wild-type Fc comparator was not included, this reflects the Fc-YTE format (M252Y/S254T/T256E, which enhances binding to FcRn to extend serum half-life) as a whole. A tandem 0G8/1B6 construct did not show a statistically significant improvement in neutralization compared to the Fc fusions (IC50 = 1.08 μg/mL, ≈36 nM). Computational docking placed the two VHHs on non-overlapping surfaces of the G head, raising the hypothesis that a tandem format could enhance neutralization; however, this synergy was not experimentally observed and requires further format optimization. These VHHs provide starting points for NiV antibody development and require authentic virus and in vivo evaluation.

A tandem 0G8/1B6 construct did not show a statistically significant improvement in neutralization compared to the Fc fusions (IC50 = 1.08 μg/mL, ≈36 nM). Computational docking placed the two VHHs on non-overlapping surfaces of the G head, raising the hypothesis that a tandem format could enhance neutralization; however, this synergy was not experimentally observed and requires further format optimization. These VHHs provide starting points for NiV antibody development and require authentic virus and in vivo evaluation.

papers.abstract_zh: 尼帕病毒 (NiV) 是世界卫生组织优先考虑的病原体,病死率为 40-75%,并且没有 抗病毒药物 治疗药物被许可用于人类。附着糖蛋白 (G) 介导受体结合,是中和抗体的有效靶点。在这里,我们的目的是分离羊驼衍生的针对 NiV G 头结构域的单域抗体 (VHH)。使用杆状病毒表达的截短 NiV G 胞外域(残基 170-575)对两只羊驼进行免疫;来自高反应动物的外周血单核细胞被用来构建 3.2 × 108 转化体的免疫噬菌体展示库。四轮生物淘选将抗原特异性噬菌体富集约 120 倍,并对 183 个反应性克隆进行测序,产生了 7 个独特的 VHH。通过 ELISA 观察到,所有七种病毒均与重组 NiV G 结合,并抑制基于 VSV 的 NiV 假病毒的进入。VHH-0G8 和 VHH-1B6 活性最高,拟合 IC50 值为 1.34 和 1.76 μg/mL(约 89 和 118 nM)。将两条引线重新格式化为人 IgG1 Fc-YTE 融合体,将拟合的 IC50 降低至 0.97 和 1.09 μg/mL(约 12 和 13 nM);由于不包括野生型 Fc 比较器,这反映了 Fc-YTE 格式(M252Y/S254T/T256E,增强与 FcRn 的结合以延长血清半衰期)的整体情况。与 Fc 融合体相比,串联 0G8/1B6 构建体在中和方面没有显示出统计上显着的改善(IC50 = 1.08 μg/mL,约 36 nM)。计算对接将两个 VHH 放置在 G 头的非重叠表面上,提出了串联格式可以增强中和作用的假设;然而,这种协同作用并未通过实验观察到,需要进一步的格式优化。这些 VHH 为 NiV 抗体开发提供了起点,并且需要真实的病毒和体内评估。

papers.title: Ontwikkeling van strategieën ter behandeling en preventie van henipavirusinfecties
papers.abstract: Henipaviruses are negative-strand RNA viruses in the Paramyxoviridae family with currently five species: Cedar, Ghanaian bat, Hendra, Mojang and Nipah henipaviruses. They are naturally harbored by pteropid fruit bats (flying foxes) and microbats of several species found throughout the tropics and subtropics. Henipavirus outbreaks in humans have occurred in northern Australia and Southeast Asia since the mid-1990s. Hendra virus (HeV) has been reported nearly annually since 1994 in the eastern states of Australia, while Nipah virus (NiV) outbreaks in humans were first reported in 1998-99 in Malaysia and Singapore and are reported almost annually in India and Bangladesh. The broad geographical distribution of the henipavirus natural animal reservoir, the high overall NiV and HeV case fatality rate in humans as well as the growing evidence of multiple routes of virus transmission, including human-to-human transmission, are causes of serious concern for henipaviruses to become epidemic or pandemic, and have turned NiV and HeV viruses into high priority pathogens of the World Health Organization (WHO). Despite the recognized high epidemic and pandemic potential of henipaviruses, no safe and effective vaccines nor therapeutics are currently available for human use. This PhD project addresses this need and aims to discover novel small molecule antivirals directly acting against henipaviruses and preferably with pan-paramyxovirus activity. To this end, the PhD project has the following aims: 1. Set up and perform a high throughput phenotypic screening assay with Cedar virus (CedV), a non-pathogenic henipavirus that can serve as a surrogate for BSL-4 NiV/HeV. Confirm and validate henipavirus antiviral activity of hit compounds in multiple complementary assays. In addition, compounds will be assessed for activity against HeV and NiV by partner institutes and for broader-spectrum anti-paramyxovirus activity. In parallel, they will be used to isolate virus variants that show phenotypic resistance to the respective compounds in a first step to unravel their precise molecular mechanism of action. Establish the first CedV infection model in mice or hamster to allow future evaluation of the efficacy of small molecules in vivo.

papers.abstract_zh: 亨尼帕病毒(亨尼帕病毒)是副粘病毒科(Paramyxoviridae)中的负链RNA病毒,目前包含五个物种: Cedar病毒、加纳果蝠病毒、亨德拉病毒、Mojang病毒和尼帕病毒。这些病毒的天然宿主是果蝠(pteropid 果蝠)和多种微蝙蝠,广泛分布于热带和亚热带地区。自1990年代中期以来,亨尼帕病毒在人类中已出现于澳大利亚北部和东南亚地区。亨德拉病毒(HeV)自1994年以来在澳大利亚东部各州几乎每年都有报告,而尼帕病毒(NiV)在人类中的首次报告则于1998-99年出现在马来西亚和新加坡,并且在印度和孟加拉国几乎每年都有报告。亨尼帕病毒在自然动物中的广泛地理分布、人类中高总体的尼帕病毒和亨德拉病毒死亡率,以及越来越多的证据表明病毒可通过多种途径传播,包括人传人传播,这些因素都引发了对亨尼帕病毒可能成为大流行或全球大流行的严重担忧,并使尼帕病毒和亨德拉病毒成为世界卫生组织(WHO)的高优先级病原体。尽管已认识到亨尼帕病毒具有高流行和大流行潜力,但目前尚无安全有效的抗病毒药物(疫苗)或治疗方法(传播)可供人类使用。本博士项目旨在满足这一需求,致力于发现直接作用于亨尼帕病毒的新小分子抗病毒药物(抗病毒药物),并优先考虑具有广谱抗副粘病毒活性的药物。为此,本博士项目的目标如下:1. 建立并执行一项针对Cedar病毒(CedV)的高通量表型筛选实验,CedV是一种非致病性的亨尼帕病毒,可作为BSL-4级别尼帕病毒/亨德拉病毒的替代物。确认并验证筛选中发现的化合物对亨尼帕病毒的活性,并在多种互补实验中进行验证。此外,这些化合物将由合作伙伴机构评估其对亨德拉病毒和尼帕病毒的活性,并评估其更广泛的抗副粘病毒活性。同时,这些化合物将用于分离表现出对相应化合物表型抗性的病毒变种,以初步揭示其精确的分子作用机制。建立小鼠或仓鼠中的首个CedV感染模型,以便未来评估小分子药物在体内的有效性。

papers.title: Endothelial protein C receptor is an entry receptor for Langya virus
papers.abstract: Langya virus (LayV) was recently discovered in infected individuals with febrile illness and classified as a Parahenipavirus, a group of poorly understood pathogens. LayV is distantly related to Nipah henipavirus which causes recurring outbreaks with case fatality rates reaching up to 90%. No vaccines or therapeutics are approved for use in humans for any parahenipavirus or henipavirus despite their broad geographic distribution and pandemic potential. Here, we discovered that human endothelial protein C receptor (EPCR) is an entry receptor for LayV and that the tetrameric LayV attachment glycoprotein (G) binds EPCR avidly. We reveal the molecular basis of LayV G recognition of the EPCR receptor and provide a blueprint of the determinants of receptor ortholog usage. We found that human and shrew EPCR orthologs promote cell entry of LayV and of the closely related Mojiang pseudoviruses. These results along with the detection of several Parahenipaviruses in shrews set these pathogens apart from Henipaviruses, which use Pteropid fruit bats as reservoir hosts. Our data support future surveillance efforts, by enabling prediction of EPCR utilization among newly discovered Parahenipaviruses, and the development and evaluation of countermeasures targeting this emerging group of human pathogens.

analysis.summary_en: This study identifies the endothelial protein C receptor (EPCR) as an entry receptor for Langya virus (LayV), a newly discovered Parahenipavirus. The research highlights the molecular mechanism by which LayV's attachment glycoprotein binds to EPCR, offering insights into receptor usage among related viruses. The findings suggest that LayV and closely related Mojiang pseudoviruses utilize EPCR for cell entry, distinguishing them from Henipaviruses, which rely on Pteropid fruit bats as reservoir hosts. The study underscores the need for targeted surveillance and development of countermeasures against emerging Parahenipaviruses. papers.abstract_zh: 最近在患有发热性疾病的感染者中发现了琅琊病毒(LayV),并将其归类为副亨尼帕病毒属,这是一组人们知之甚少的病原体。LayV 与 Nipah 亨尼帕病毒 有远亲关系,后者会导致 暴发 反复发作,病死率高达 90%。尽管副亨尼帕病毒或 亨尼帕病毒 的地理分布广泛且具有大流行的潜力,但尚未批准用于人类的 疫苗 或疗法。在这里,我们发现人内皮蛋白 C 受体 (EPCR) 是 LayV 的进入受体,并且四聚体 LayV 附着糖蛋白 (G) 强烈结合 EPCR。我们揭示了 LayVG 识别 EPCR 受体的分子基础,并提供了受体直向同源物使用的决定因素的蓝图。我们发现人类和鼩鼱的 EPCR 直系同源物促进 LayV 和密切相关的墨江假病毒进入细胞。这些结果以及在鼩鼱体内检测到的几种副亨尼帕病毒将这些病原体与 亨尼帕病毒 区分开来,亨尼帕病毒 使用 Pteropid 果蝠 作为 储存宿主 宿主。我们的数据支持未来的 监测 工作,通过预测新发现的副亨尼帕病毒中的 EPCR 利用率,以及针对这一新兴人类病原体群的对策的开发和评估。

news.content: Dinamani Kannada Prabha Samakalika Malayalam Cinema Express Indulgexpress Edexlive Nov 10, 2026 4:43 AM Subscribe E-PAPER INDIA WORLD STATES CITIES OPINION EXPLAINER BUSINESS SPORTS GOOD NEWS ENTERTAINMENT VIDEOS LIVE BLOG INDIA WORLD STATES CITIES OPINION EXPLAINER BUSINESS SPORTS GOOD NEWS ENTERTAINMENT VIDEOS LIVE BLOG Trending Links Sharad Pawar NCP(SP) Parth Pawar PM Modi Rajamahendravaram Central Prison Editorial In Nipah probe, focus on facts, not politics Attributing deaths to expired medication without indisputable evidence would be irresponsible Kerala government procured 3,000 vials of Remdesivir in June 2021 and data validates usage beyond expiry date(Photo | AFP) Updated on: 04 Nov 2026, 8:52 pm Copied Keralam’s sustained battle against the deadly Nipah virus is a defining chapter in its impressive healthcare journey. Its handling of the first outbreak in 2018 and subsequent occurrences has earned global recognition. However, that hard-won reputation is now under serious challenge following allegations that expired doses of the antiviral drug Remdesivir were administered to Nipah patients between 2023 and 2025, during the previous LDF regime. The UDF government has constituted a medical board to ascertain whether the expired drugs contributed to the six Nipah deaths during this period, triggering a sharp backlash from the LDF and a rebuttal from health experts. The controversy offers a much-needed reality check for Keralam’s celebrated public healthcare system. It raises serious questions about inventory management, treatment protocols and administrative accountability. The state government procured 3,000 vials of Remdesivir in June 2021, with an expiry date of May 30, 2023. Data from Kozhikode Medical College show that 102 of these vials were used in 2023-24, 34 in 2024-25 and 10 in 2025-26. Health Minister K Muraleedharan, who flagged the possible lapses, said that the packages carried an expiry date but no manufacturing date, and some stock was labelled ‘For clinical trial use’. Dismissing the suspicion, critical care specialist Dr A S Anoop Kumar said none of the six Nipah fatalities between 2023 and 2025 had received Remdesivir from the medical college, as all were diagnosed only after death. Attributing deaths to expired medication without indisputable evidence would be irresponsible. Nipah is an exceptionally dangerous infection, and the effectiveness of drugs remains far from conclusive. But that does not make the questions any less serious. Why was the medical college retaining out-of-date medication? Was any of it administered to patients? Any lapse in procurement, storage or inventory management must be identified and responsibility fixed. If this leads to a better treatment protocol, that would be a bonus for a state battling recurring outbreaks. However, accountability must not become a pretext for discrediting a system built over decades. Nor should a serious public health issue degenerate into a political slugfest. Keralam’s healthcare system must remain open to scrutiny precisely because its achievements are worth protecting. The priority must be to establish facts, address systemic deficiencies and strengthen public confidence, not to score political points. supplementary_news.content: Dinamani Kannada Prabha Samakalika Malayalam Cinema Express Indulgexpress Edexlive Nov 10, 2026 4:43 AM Subscribe E-PAPER INDIA WORLD STATES CITIES OPINION EXPLAINER BUSINESS SPORTS GOOD NEWS ENTERTAINMENT VIDEOS LIVE BLOG INDIA WORLD STATES CITIES OPINION EXPLAINER BUSINESS SPORTS GOOD NEWS ENTERTAINMENT VIDEOS LIVE BLOG Trending Links Sharad Pawar NCP(SP) Parth Pawar PM Modi Rajamahendravaram Central Prison Advertisement Keralam INTERVIEW | ‘Nipah will keep recurring, 50 per cent of bats there must be infected’ The former additional chief secretary shares with TNIE his views on the health of the state’s health sector, Keralites’ obsession with healthcare and specialists, and his own experiences in handling the deadly Nipah and Covid. Express Dialogue Rajeev Sadanandan former Additional Chief Secretary of Health & Family Welfare for the Government of Kerala.Photo | Albin Mathew Express News Service Updated on: 08 Nov 2026, 2:11 am 11 min read Copied Former Health Secretary Rajeev Sadanandan is a name synonymous with healthcare policy in Keralam. Currently a member of the technical advisory panel of the World Bank’s Pandemic Fund, he was closely associated with the state’s successful Nipah battle and later during the Covid pandemic. Amid controversies including those over Nipah and SMA medicines, the former additional chief secretary shares with TNIE his views on the health of the state’s health sector, Keralites’ obsession with healthcare and specialists, and his own experiences in handling the deadly Nipah and Covid. Excerpts The Kerala Model remains widely accepted with health and education as its cornerstones. But you recently said we must drop the assumption that Keralam is unconditionally number one in public health... There is a common misconception that Keralam’s healthcare sector was exceptionally advanced from the start. The foundation of public health investments dates back to the 1830s in Travancore, with the establishment of the first hospitals. After Kerala formation, successive administrations invested heavily in health and education. By late 1960s, we had reached the pinnacle of the Kerala Model. When Keralam invested heavily in human capital, it created a structural challenge: public expenditure kept climbing without corresponding economic returns, culminating in a fiscal crisis by 1975. Complacency crept in after we achieved international reputation. We must adapt our policies to secure continuous gains in the sector. We are often too fixated on our past achievements to adapt fast enough. Could you elaborate on how this gap affects the public healthcare delivery mechanism today? In 2011, when I became health secretary, I saw a major problem—hypertension and diabetes had both spiked significantly. It happened because we neither collected actual data nor recognised the changing circumstances to formulate a response. We are yet to look at new issues. What will be the difference in climate health? What are the problems of ageing? We lack the tradition to understand such scenarios or respond to it. But we usually get health data from institutions. So, did the flow decrease or was it because surveillance cells became deficient that we didn’t get early data? Health data comes from two reliable sources – National Sample Survey and National Family Health Survey. Based on its data analysis, we ponder over policy changes. The problem is that transparency is politically expensive. I told Shailaja Teacher that we must not hide data. She agreed. During the Nipah outbreak, we got a lot of credit for being 100% transparent. Handling Nipah was a major task. How was your initial response? There was a lot of panic at the time. I used to get up from sleep at midnight. Nipah mortality is between 70 and 100%. We were 18 days late and could not identify the extent of the spread. Simulations assessed it could go up to 254 cases in the whole of Malabar. We were prepared for 300 cases. We were short of PPE kits. We didn’t know what to do. Some say it was a PR exercise, but those who went through it knew how serious it was then. The things we did were against the rule books. We set up a research committee with assistance from WHO. The state can’t do these on its own, but we still did it as the times demanded so. I could have been dismissed for each of the steps taken at the time. How do you rate the leadership of Shailaja at the time? She always respects advice. I had a free hand. Credit should also go to T P Ramakrishnan, MLA, who was on the ground from the onset. They both played a role in the leadership. Shailaja Teacher led from the front. There were people who refused to talk to the press at that time. But she took responsibility. She could have put the onus on officers and sat back, but she didn’t. The way Nipah was handled by the then state government was much appreciated. However, there are recurring outbreaks... The medium is Pteropus medius, a fruit bat. When these bats contact each other, the virus spreads. But bats don’t die; rather, they become carriers and spread the virus fast. Around 22% of them were infected then. So we knew the colony would always remain. Nipah is reported in Bangladesh every year. In Keralam too, there will be a recurrence every year. The very next year, I issued a circular urging everyone to be prepared because the host population is heavily infected. In a densely-populated state like Keralam, and with the high human-animal interaction, it will keep recurring. Fifty percent of the bats there must be infected now. Why are cases reported only from Kozhikode? In 2019, there was a case in Idukki. It can happen anywhere. We are transparent and disclose the numbers. Others don’t. Has there been any attempt or pressure to hide the data? Some media do create issues. So, politicians get extremely worried. During Covid, the number of deaths should not have been under-reported. There is always pressure to hide data. Has the Nipah episode exposed any problems in our system? Have we tried to rectify the same? Our review gave out two important outputs: surveillance and infection control in government hospitals had to go up. Firstly, according to our guidelines, if a young person comes with brain-related issues, we must take a sample and send it for testing. Since that was not done, around 13 infections occurred there. Secondly, the highest number of infections occurred in hospital settings, which meant that infection control in hospitals was very poor. We made a major improvement and its benefit was reaped during the Covid-19 period. Speaking about Covid, what’s your assessment on how it was handled? Screening people who came from Wuhan based on epidemiological intelligence and picking up their samples was an excellent move... only Keralam could have done that. During the Nipah period, we acquired the skill of contact tracing. When lockdown happened, not even a single case from outside could enter. Once that control eased, a huge wave was bound to happen. But overall, I think we did a fantastic job, except for the case of unnecessary cover-up of the death toll. Conspiracy theories about Covid are still active in the public sphere, as in it was deliberately manufactured. Is it an American-funded project? When we look at the genome sequence of the Covid virus from Wuhan in China, it looks normal. A small section that would aggravate infection was found. That was the accusation. The conspiracy theory was that it escaped from the lab and infected people. No one knows whether the SARS virus, which was created in the lab, escaped from there. You once mentioned in an article that Nipah deaths totalled 23... Nipah case was first detected in 2018. But that was the third or fourth case, and by then, three others had died. On tracing, we found that one of the cases arrived on May 5. If there is reasonable ground to suspect Nipah based on contact and clinical symptoms, that can be termed a case. We counted only 19 cases. In my article, the number of deaths is mentioned as 23 because we retrospectively added cases that were not counted earlier. The current health minister recently alleged that outdated medicines were given to Nipah patients... It is highly unlikely and can be proved easily. He should have made the statement only after verifying. They can check the case-sheets and see if Remdesivir was given to patients. KMSCL (Kerala Medical Services Corporation Limited) has a procurement invoice, stock register and a register to record transfer of medicines to hospitals. When a minister makes such allegations, it raises concerns among the public. Also, such talk demoralises healthcare workers. In Keralam, after the corporatisation of hospitals, common people have only government hospitals to go to. We have to verify and take action if there are lapses. If unverified, it should not be disclosed because even the PR (machinery) of corporate hospitals tries to stoke controversies. Government hospitals are under attack. We should not worsen the issue. You have served as health secretary under both LDF and UDF governments. How do you rate the approach of the respective chief ministers? Both Oommen Chandy and Pinarayi Vijayan were supportive. Oommen Chandy used to tell me that we have to do a lot of things in the health sector. Whenever ministers posed problems, I went to him. The same with Pinarayi as well. He had genuine interest in the health sector. (Former) Finance Minister Thomas Isaac was among the faculty at CDS (Centre for Development Studies, Thiruvananthapuram) and I had a connection with him. I channelled a lot of his cash (laughs) to the sector. The healthcare-seeking tendency among Malayalis is quite high. We go to hospitals even for a cold... In NSS (National Sample Survey), there’s a question on whether a person has sought treatment for a disease. The number of patients who sought treatment divided by the population and multiplied by 1,000... that’s how the exact number is arrived at. Kerala’s data is 320. In Tamil Nadu, it is 180. In other states, it is less than 100. It is an inculcated habit to consult a doctor even for a cold. The industry fosters this habit. There’s another tendency. We go to a neurologist for a headache. What the doctors urge is to consult a specialist doctor. When we say healthcare expenditure, it is mostly caused when we bypass a primary physician and go to specialists and do all the tests. Health experts are calling for the family physician system to be implemented in Keralam, but we failed. Why? If a family physician comes in, many issues will be solved easily. When ESI was implemented, it was said there should not be any direct reference, and only references through clinics were allowed. People raised an issue in Keralam. People here think they have the right to consult any doctor based on the symptoms. This leads to increased healthcare expenses. You once said there will come a time when treatment will become unaffordable even for the upper middle-class... Health inflation is high mostly because of technology. The price will always increase as new technology will keep coming. The expectations of people will also go up and the price of drugs will rise. The government does not have any regulation. In places where the expense is controlled, there will be gatekeeping and rationing of hospitals. We can use many techniques to control healthcare expenditure, as done in many countries except the US. However, we emulate the US model. In insurance, the claim rejection rate is very high. Is there a regulatory body in the sector to work between the people and the insurance agencies? In all the places I’m talking about, one thing is common: universal health coverage for every individual, except the US. At one point, this wasn’t a problem for us because our costs were very low. Now, without bringing insurance companies and perhaps health managed-care institutions together into a consolidated system, this kind of control may not be possible. Medical inflation is a major issue. Do we have data on this? No such data is available. I made an attempt, around 2012-13, to get data from private hospitals. But they did not provide it. There is deep mistrust between the private sector and the government. Unless that changes, no one will give this data... unless it is made mandatory. Why would private hospitals not trust the government? I don’t know much about the private hospital business. But looking at their costs, around 20-25% goes on doctors’ salaries and another 25% on other salaries. Some doctors are like Mohanlal and Mammootty; they are paid whatever they ask for and that cannot be disclosed. Why are the hospitals unwilling to share prices? They have blocked it for the past seven years, because they fix prices based on people’s income. Suppose you have insurance; your rate will be adjusted. If they see that you are reasonably well-off, the rate will be higher. There’s opposition because they think price disclosure will affect their business model. Recently, Chief Minister V D Satheesan pointed to how everyone coming for an angiogram ends up with an angioplasty... Don’t take the former health secretary to court (smiles). Let me come from another angle. Say a cardiologist is paid Rs 10 lakh a month. Does he have to generate money equal to that? Earlier, someone told me a pulmonologist was being paid a huge amount. I asked how they could recover that much. The answer: bronchoscopy made compulsory for every case. You mentioned price regulation earlier. Do you see any possibility of implementing this in private hospitals in some form? When we drafted the Clinical Establishments Act, we took the Central Act as our model. It says, “Government shall fix the prices.” I realised that this wasn’t going to work here. At the time, we couldn’t even fix the fees in medical colleges. How could we possibly fix the rates for 2,500 procedures? Instead, we introduced a provision requiring hospitals to disclose their rates. I still believe that’s sufficient. If rates charged by different hospitals are publicly available, people can choose. Under the Clinical Establishments Act, hospitals are required to disclose the names and qualifications of the doctors. If something like this develops, the market itself will determine things to a certain extent. Even without fixing prices directly, some degree of rationality will emerge. In the modern world, transparency is the best remedy for most of the problems arising from withholding of information. From a policy perspective, when we allocate resources, should we focus on non-communicable diseases (NCDs) or should we prioritise contagious diseases, pandemics and future pandemics? When we talk about primary care, infectious diseases are certainly one of the important areas. At the same time, data shows that hypertension and diabetes are also increasing. Unless we invest in long-term behavioural change and prevention, we will be overwhelmed. Keralam needs to invest in preventing NCDs rather than continuously expanding treatment facilities. Keralam is often described as the capital of lifestyle diseases... I don’t agree with that description. It is incorrect to call Keralam the capital of all such diseases. Our detection rates are higher, and consequently, more people receive treatment. We are also an ageing population. Even in terms of NCD prevalence, we are probably the third highest or somewhere around that. Higher detection rates explain much of the difference. What has changed in the lifestyle of Malayalis to contribute to the growing incidence of NCDs? In the past, physical activity was naturally integrated into our lives. Our food habits have also changed, with greater consumption of unhealthy foods including those containing trans-fats. Another major concern is the declining physical activity among children. In many schools, physical education periods are replaced with additional classes. We are effectively creating an obese generation. Also, children spend very little time outdoors, raising concerns about vitamin D deficiency. The future could be much worse. With life expectancy increasing, nearly 30% of Keralam’s population is projected to be senior citizens soon. How should the state prepare for this demographic transition? We need to distinguish between life span and health span. The real question is not merely how long people live, but how many of those years they live in good health. Many people spend the last five years of their lives as patients. We don’t even allow people to die with dignity. Is there a difference between the number of years people lived in good health in the past and the number of years they live in good health today? That’s a question that needs to be examined. What are the major areas where Keralam’s healthcare policy has fallen short? If I were to look back and ask what I would have done differently, I would identify NCD prevention as one major area. Healthy ageing is another area in which we have not invested adequately. These are two major gaps that could become serious challenges in the coming years. At the same time, Keralam has achieved a great deal in healthcare and several other sectors. Can you explain the controversy over the Medical Service Corporation’s membership at the Thiruvananthapuram Tennis Club when you were the health secretary? There are other PSUs which take membership. I had just joined there from the KSEB, which too has a membership at the Tennis Club. At the time, we held several conferences at the Mascot Hotel. The Tennis Club has similar facilities. In fact, I don’t play tennis Is it true that unemployment is increasing among doctors? I think we now have 23 medical colleges. They are producing 4,000 doctors. Naturally, there must be unemployment. In certain specialties, it is very difficult to get jobs, for instance cardiologists. We don’t need more medical colleges. There are speculations of a possible future pandemic. How do you assess the Kerala…
